cell-size table, world rect, pools, root. Exact: the extents are written as chained assignments (`float w = field_0x50 = x1 - x0;`), which gives retail's `fst [field]` plus the spill temporary; reading the field back after a separate store does not.

3.6% match. Same control flow. Register allocation differs: retail has a 0x34 frame, spills `this` to esp+8, keeps depth in ebp, x in edx and z in ebx, and moves the Grow path out of line. The candidate has a 0x30 frame with `this` in ebx. Loop-form variants (count-down, 0..depth, if/else order) stay between 2% and 4%.

11.3% match. Same control flow. Retail keeps `this` in ebp and code, i and bit in memory; the candidate holds code in esi and i in ebp. Tried without success: a goto/flag-free form, an if-body without continue, `0x10 << i`, recomputing x/z/cell in the loop, and moving cell inside the loop.

append obj to the node's first free item slot, allocating a 0x14 block from the pool. Exact: the fresh block is cleared with memset(p, 0, sizeof) (VC6 inlines it as `mov edx,eax; xor ecx,ecx; mov [edx],ecx` x5; field stores give `mov [eax+N],0`), and `prev` is left uninitialised on the empty-list path, which reproduces retail's dead load at 0x4dd165.

88.0% (329 vs 330 bytes). Same algorithm (qsort with CompareObjectKey, 2-element swap inline). Exact up to the outer loop's bottom: retail ends the loop with `cmp eax,edi; je ret0; jmp top` and puts the return-0 block last, but VC6 rotates every while/for(;;) loop whose top is a conditional exit into a bottom `jne body`. That shape has not been reproduced yet.

inline helper; retail keeps this out-of-line COMDAT copy because CastSegment ran out of inline budget. Height/normal query (58 callers). Checkerboard triangle split, inverse-squared-distance corner weights. Retail uses an EBP frame and inline fistp through pointer-aliased int locals (inline __asm in original source, not reproducible under rules); inherent partial. Also VC6 inline budget differs on Vec3 helpers.

56.6% (1659 vs 1654). The first 0x3b7 bytes are identical. The Clip helpers are now `inline` with reference params, `-dir` is passed as a temporary, and operator/ builds the result with a direct constructor call. What remains is VC6's inline budget: retail does not inline the ClipZ for the Z end point and inlines the next `-dir`, but this source inlines that ClipZ and so runs out of budget one site early. See the comment above CastSegment.
